name: Atomic 2020
description: Atomic 2020 is a commonsense knowledge graph (CSKG) designed to provide general-purpose commonsense knowledge not readily available in pretrained language models. It serves as a resource for training knowledge models to generate accurate and representative knowledge for new, unseen entities and events, and is evaluated through comparison with other CSKGs and human evaluation.
reputation: A relatively new commonsense knowledge graph benchmark that has seen use mainly in research on commonsense knowledge generation and representation rather than broad community-wide leaderboard adoption.
notes: Focuses on evaluating the utility of knowledge graphs for implicit knowledge representation and generation; includes human evaluation comparing GPT-3 and BART-based models.
